text:
rachel_sales: Heads-up: Demo with Emmas team just hit repeated SSE disconnects. Client shows "Unexpected end of event" and UI stops. They said its more common on iOS over cellular. Can we triage?

jason_eng: copying logs would help. Did the app capture the network trace or the raw SSE bytes?

emma_mobile: app console shows parse errors and sometimes "Invalid event: incomplete data". I grabbed the SDK debug dump and saw a trailing partial UTF8 sequence, then the connection closed. Also noticed a 503 from edge once.

nate_sre: checking edge/NLB. Give me the time window.

rachel_sales: started at 1825001234, issue reproduced ~20s in.

nate_sre: I see a spike of 502/503s at the same second and a proxy initiated FIN on a few streams. Also a rate-limiter returned 429 for one backend pod slightly earlier. forwarding trace ids to jason.

jason_eng: interesting  two possible causes: 1) intermediary/proxy coalescing + truncating chunked streams, 2) our rate limiter or upstream crashing mid-stream. We should inspect app runtime logs for uncaught panics.

emma_mobile: raw fragment from the SDK (hex truncated):
```
646174613a207b226368756e6b223a20224c6f72656d20497073e280
```
It ends with `e2 80` (incomplete multibyte).

nate_sre: thats a classic mid-multibyte truncation. Im going to check nginx buffering flags and the LB idle timeout. Also will look at WAF for any body transforms.

jason_eng: immediate mitigations: emit periodic SSE comments (e.g., `: keepalive\n\n`) every 8-10s, force flusher after each 
```
